<section id="troubleshooting">
<h1>Troubleshooting</h1>
<!-- docledger-section: troubleshooting-status-reports-uninitialized -->
<section id="status-reports-uninitialized">
<h2><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">status</span></code> reports <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">uninitialized</span></code></h2>
<p>The workspace is not initialized. Run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">memledger init</span></code> from the repository root to create the canonical <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ledger/</span></code> layout. If you have a legacy <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.memoryledger</span></code> directory, use the explicit migration workflow instead.</p>
<!-- docledger-section: troubleshooting-scan-fails-with-storage-missing -->
</section>
<section id="scan-fails-with-storage-missing">
<h2><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">scan</span></code> fails with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">storage_missing</span></code></h2>
<p>The configuration file exists but the storage metadata is missing. This can happen if the workspace was partially initialized or if the storage files were deleted. Run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">memledger init</span></code> again to recreate the storage layout, or use the migration workflow if you have a legacy layout.</p>
<!-- docledger-section: troubleshooting-mark-fresh-fails-with-unlinked-memory -->
</section>
<section id="mark-fresh-fails-with-unlinked-memory">
<h2><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mark-fresh</span></code> fails with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">unlinked_memory</span></code></h2>
<p>The memory file has no linked evidence. This error prevents tracking a memory file that can never become stale from evidence changes. If the memory file is intentionally unlinked (e.g., a navigation page), pass <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--allow-unlinked</span></code> with a reason. Otherwise, add links to the memory file first using <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">memledger links add</span></code>.</p>
<!-- docledger-section: troubleshooting-every-change-makes-too-many-memory-entries-stale -->
</section>
<section id="every-change-makes-too-many-memory-entries-stale">
<h2>Every change makes too many memory entries stale</h2>
<p>This usually means links are too broad. Whole-file links track the file fallback unit, so any change to the file makes all linked entries stale. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">memledger links add-entry</span></code> to create precise entry-level links that track specific evidence units (functions, classes, methods) instead of whole files. This way, only the entries linked to the changed unit become stale.</p>
<!-- docledger-section: troubleshooting-a-changed-source-is-reported-as-unlinked -->
</section>
<section id="a-changed-source-is-reported-as-unlinked">
<h2>A changed source is reported as unlinked</h2>
<p>The evidence file changed but has no link record. This means no memory entry is tracking this evidence. If the evidence is relevant to memory, add a link using <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">memledger links add</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">memledger links add-entry</span></code>. If the evidence is intentionally untracked (e.g., test files or generated code), you can ignore the warning.</p>
<!-- docledger-section: troubleshooting-storage-migration-errors -->
</section>
<section id="storage-migration-errors">
<h2>Storage migration errors</h2>
<p>If migration fails, check the error message for details. Common issues include:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Missing source files: The migration validates that evidence files referenced in links still exist. If files were moved or deleted, update the links before migrating.</p></li>
<li><p>Duplicate edges: The migration detects duplicate links and reports them. Remove duplicates before migrating.</p></li>
<li><p>Schema version mismatch: The migration requires a specific ledgercore schema version. Update ledgercore if needed.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">memledger storage migrate --dry-run --plan-file migration.json</span></code> to preview the migration plan without applying it. Review the plan, then run without <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--dry-run</span></code> to apply.</p>
</section>
</section>
